question.text:
Consider the system of linear equations:
$$
\begin{aligned}
& x_1+2 x_2+x_3=3 \\
& 2 x_1+3 x_2+x_3=3 \\
& 3 x_1+5 x_2+2 x_3=1
\end{aligned}
$$
The system has

solution.text:
$$
\begin{aligned}
& D=\left|\begin{array}{lll}
1 & 2 & 1 \\
2 & 3 & 1 \\
3 & 5 & 2
\end{array}\right|=0 \\
& D_1=\left|\begin{array}{lll}
3 & 2 & 1 \\
3 & 3 & 1 \\
1 & 5 & 2
\end{array}\right| \neq 0
\end{aligned}
$$
$\Rightarrow$ Given system, does not have any solution.
$\Rightarrow$ No solution.
